status: STUDY ONLY - local; production engine (tutor_cat/, scripts/scenario_cat_lib.py) untouched; nothing committed.

bank_representation.note: InfoBench has NO persisted per-item fitted-param jsonl. The of-record OOS grid refits the log-shrinkage-2PL bank on-the-fly from the frozen response matrix (per-fold for OOS; full-data for the sound SE_param). The 'bank' shipped here is therefore the exact calibration INPUT the grid consumed, not an exported param file. To materialise deployment params, re-run scripts/run_oos_grid.py (which fits with the config below).

cohort.judge: frozen Qwen zero-shot binary labels (Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B, prompt judge-validation-v3)

fit_result.loglik_note: The of-record grid does NOT persist a single full-data log-likelihood; it refits per fold under returned_iterate convergence (parameter_tol 5e-5). For provenance, the 5 OOS folds ran to max_iter=200 (returned-iterate stop), keeping n_kept in [2088, 2101] variant items each; the full-data SE_param free-2PL fit kept n_items=2096. Re-run scripts/run_oos_grid.py to reproduce; the objective is available from calibrate_mirt at fit time.

se_param_note: SE_total = sqrt(SE_post^2 + SE_param^2). SE_param is the SOUND observed-information parametric bootstrap (full-data, reused across folds; CAT-admin median ~0.085, full-admin floor median ~0.041). This SUPERSEDES the earlier teammate ~0.19 from the STALE nonparametric person-resample-refit script scripts/scenario_param_uncertainty.py (see README 'SE_param correction').
identifiability_caveat: N=52 persons < min_persons_identifiable=150; multi-dim loadings are unstable at this sample size, which is why the canonical InfoBench scale is UNIDIMENSIONAL (instruction_following).
